benchmarks.label: Brent

peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Settled at $116.72 on 23 Oct, up 3.1% on the day and about 10% w/w, its highest close since 29 Apr, as markets priced in reports the US and Israel are planning renewed strikes on Iran after the Nov 3 midterms and continuing Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. Week-ago is this site's 16 Oct reading, exactly 7 days earlier.

benchmarks.label: TTF gas

peak.note: New 2026 high, surpassing the prior 93.80 set 23 Oct (Trading Economics).

benchmarks.note: Rose to a fresh 2026 high of about €93.86 on 23 Oct (Trading Economics), up roughly 6% w/w, as EU storage fell to 74.62% of capacity — the lowest seasonal level since 2009 — and Middle East LNG shipments stayed about 80% below year-ago levels. Week-ago is this site's 16 Oct reading, exactly 7 days earlier. Pre-crisis €32.00 is derived from RTÉ's figure of +€14.52 to €46.52 on 2 March.
